create_runner_subclass: create a python class that inherits from Runner and implements run, save_state, and load_state methods
test_mockrunner: test the MockRunner class by creating an instance with x, y, z values and calling run to get their sum
implement_preemptablemixin: implement a PreemptableMixin subclass that adds STOPFAIR preemption detection and atomic checkpointing to a Runner
handle_stopfair_preemption: handle STOPFAIR sentinel file detection by calling handle_stopfair to save state and raise StopfairDetected exception
save_atomic_checkpoint: save an atomic checkpoint using PreemptableMixin save_state that writes to a temp dir then renames into place
